## Socialite (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
Human aristocrat 2  
N Medium humanoid (human)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** Perception +0  

**Defense**

 **AC** 12, touch 12, flat-footed 10 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge)  
**hp** 14 (2d8–2)  
Fort—1, **Ref** +1, **Will** +3  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** unarmed strike +0 (1d3–1)  
**Ranged** taser +2 (1d10 nonlethal electricity)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** A socialite calls for help and seeks to flee, using her taser to attempt to knock out her attacker and give her time to escape or find an improvised weapon if escape is impossible.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 8, **Dex** 13, **Con** 9, **Int** 11, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +0; **CMD** 12  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Diplomacy)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Bluff +6, Diplomacy +10, Knowledge (nobility) +5, Knowledge (religion) +4, Perform (dance) +7, Perform (sing, string instruments) +6, Ride +5, Sense Motive +4  
**Languages** Common  
**Gear** noble’s outfit, signet ring, 310 gp
